evidence: poleBranch uses exactly [M]'s cubics A(A-e)(A+3e) and A(Az^2-eH)(Az^2+3eH) with the guard AeHz != 0, and polePredicate_sound needs only p > 3 prime and p-adic-unit multipliers. The values of m are the signed divisors of 2730=2*3*5*7*13, which are units exactly at primes outside S_0, so this generalizes Lemma 5.1. [N]'s own copy of Phi(B) (ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.pole) has no bridge to polePredicate, as the claim says.

polePredicate_sound has only the hypotheses p prime, p > 3, every multiplier a p-adic unit, polePredicate M B and odd v_p(B), and poleBranch uses [M]'s curves with A+3e and Az^2+3eH; with M the 64 values of m it is the lemma for p not in S_0, so it is more general in M. Grep finds no theorem relating ManuscriptV15.Arithmetic.pole (Phi) to polePredicate, and [N]'s multiplier sets (smallMultipliers) are not 2730's divisors, so the missing bridge is accurately noted.
